versions.description:
Sell, grant, and maintain configurable 7 Days to Die buff packages through Takaro. BuffManager helps admins turn buffs into permissioned, timed, and currency-backed player perks.

Use this module to:
- Configure multiple buff packages with display names and command triggers.
- Require roles or permissions for specific buff packages.
- Charge Takaro currency for player-selected buffs.
- Track expirations and reapply active buffs when players reconnect.
- Give staff admin commands for manual buff and debuff workflows.

Good fit for 7 Days to Die servers that want VIP buffs, paid perks, timed role benefits, or economy-connected buff rewards.

## Module details

# Dynamic Buff Manager

Flexible buff management system that supports unlimited buff packages with role requirements, expiration tracking, and currency costs.

## Features
- ✅ Unlimited buff packages (add as many as you need)
- ✅ Role-based access control per package
- ✅ Time-based expiration system
- ✅ Auto-apply buffs on player connect
- ✅ Currency costs per package
- ✅ Automatic maintenance to keep buffs active

## Quick Start

1. **Add a Buff Package**
   - Click "Add Item" under Buff Packages
   - Set Command Name (e.g., "vipbuff")
   - Set Display Name (e.g., "VIP Speed Package")
   - Add buff names from your XML (e.g., "SpeedbuffVip")

2. **Get Role ID**
   - Go to Settings → Roles in Takaro
   - Click on the role you want (e.g., "VIP")
   - Look at the browser address bar: `https://your-takaro.com/settings/roles/743b9623-ad09-4cf2-86c0-3d7faed57a88`
   - Copy the UUID from the URL (the part after `/roles/`)
   - Example: `743b9623-ad09-4cf2-86c0-3d7faed57a88`
   - Paste into "Required Role ID" field
   - Leave empty to allow everyone

3. **Configure Duration**
   - Set how long buffs should last in minutes
   - 0 = no Takaro expiry tracking. The buff is applied by `/getbuff` or auto-apply, but maintenance only maintains packages that have an expiry variable.
   - 60 = expires after 1 hour

4. **Save and Install**

## Configuration Fields

### Buff Package Settings

- **Command Name**: What players type (creates /getbuff commandName)
- **Display Name**: Friendly name in messages
- **Description**: Explanation of what the package does
- **Buff Names**: Array of buff codes from your buffs.xml
- **Required Role ID**: UUID of the role (copy from browser URL). Empty = everyone
- **Duration (Minutes)**: Takaro tracking/maintenance window. 0 = no expiry tracking
- **Auto-Apply on Connect**: Give buff automatically when player joins
- **Currency Cost**: Price to use the command

### Examples

**VIP Package:**
- Command: "vipbuff"
- Buffs: ["SpeedbuffVip", "ExpBuffVip"]
- Role: 743b9623-ad09-4cf2-86c0-3d7faed57a88
- Duration: 0 (permanent)
- Auto-apply: Yes
- Cost: 0

**Temporary Donor Buff:**
- Command: "donorbuff"
- Buffs: ["SuperSpeed", "SuperJump"]
- Role: abc-123-donor-role-id
- Duration: 120 (2 hours)
- Auto-apply: No
- Cost: 1000

## How It Works

1. **On Player Connect**: Module checks all packages with auto-apply enabled and matching roles
2. **Manual Command**: Player uses /getbuff <packageName> to activate a specific package
3. **Expiration Tracking**: Module stores expiration timestamp per player per package
4. **Maintenance**: Cronjob re-applies non-expired timed buffs on its schedule. The included cronjob is scheduled every minute; adjust the cronjob schedule in Takaro if you want a different cadence.


## Important: BuffManager duration vs 7D2D XML duration

BuffManager has two different duration concepts:

- **BuffManager package duration** controls how long Takaro tracks the player as owning the package. When a player runs `/getbuff <package>`, BuffManager stores a Takaro variable such as `buff_expiry_<package>` with the expiry timestamp.
- **7D2D XML buff duration** controls how long each actual in-game buff application lasts. BuffManager applies buffs by sending a normal console command such as `buffplayer "playername" buffName`. That command does not include a duration, so 7D2D reads the duration and stack/refresh behavior from your server/mod XML, usually `buffs.xml`.

The maintenance cronjob is a keep-alive loop for timed packages. It does not inspect the live 7D2D buff timer. It checks Takaro's saved expiry variable for online players:

- If the package has not expired, maintenance sends `buffplayer "playername" buffName` again to refresh/reapply the buff.
- If the package has expired, maintenance sends `debuffplayer "playername" buffName` and deletes the Takaro tracking variable.
- If package duration is `0`, BuffManager does not create an expiry variable for maintenance to check. The buff can still be applied by `/getbuff`, `/buffplayer`, or auto-apply on connect, but it is not part of the timed maintenance loop.

For clean behavior, set the XML duration and stacking behavior intentionally. If maintenance runs every minute, a short XML duration such as 60-90 seconds usually works well: Takaro refreshes while the package is active, then removes the buff when the Takaro package expires. Avoid very long XML durations unless you are comfortable with possible tail time if a buff was refreshed shortly before expiry and removal does not run cleanly.

## Troubleshooting

**Buffs not applying:**
- Check buff names match your buffs.xml exactly (case-sensitive)
- Verify role ID is correct UUID from browser URL
- Check player actually has the role assigned
- Look at module execution events for detailed logs

**Buffs disappearing:**
- Check duration - timed packages may be expiring, or duration 0 may not be tracked by maintenance
- Verify maintenance is enabled and the maintenance cronjob schedule is what you expect
- Check game server console for buff command errors

**Currency not deducting:**
- Verify economy is enabled in Takaro settings
- Check currency cost is set correctly per package

commands.name: buffplayer
commands.helpText: Admin command to apply a buff package to any player

arguments.name: playerName
arguments.helpText: Name of the player to buff

arguments.name: packageName
arguments.helpText: Name of the buff package to apply

commands.name: debuffplayer
commands.helpText: Remove buff tracking from a player. If packageName is not specified, removes all buffs. Usage: /debuffplayer <playerName> [packageName]

arguments.name: playerName
arguments.helpText: Name of the player to debuff

arguments.name: packageName
arguments.helpText: The buff package name to remove

commands.name: getbuff
commands.helpText: Apply a buff package to yourself. Use /getbuff <packageName> or just /getbuff to see available packages

arguments.name: packageName
arguments.helpText: Name of the buff package to apply (optional - leave empty to list all)

hooks.name: Auto-Apply Buff Packages
hooks.description: Automatically applies buff packages to players based on role requirements when they connect

cronJobs.name: check Buff Packages
cronJobs.description: Checks Takaro buff expiry variables for online players, re-applies non-expired buffs with buffplayer, and removes expired buffs with debuffplayer.

permissions.description: Can manage and apply any buff package
